By the metre 6.6.8.6.6.8.3.3.6.6 (003-strip0.jpg) and the music, the 6-syllable poem line 9 opens on word 4 (capitalised, comma after it), as stanzas 2 and 3 open theirs on word 4 of their system 4 rows; the two 3-syllable lines are words 1-3 of this row and the last 3 words of system 3. Database line 7 runs on to take word 4 (7 words) and line 8 opens at word 5; they should end and open one word earlier (6 words, then 4). Answered by the owner on 2026-10-22, census2's ask "rows the page contradicts", option B: the row keeps the page's line starts.
